# HolyCrab Agent Tools v0.2.1

This release packages the HolyCrab CLI, local MCP server, and Agent Skill for macOS and Linux.

## Highlights

- Adds a versioned public capability snapshot with request schemas for Seedance, MiniMax H3, Seedream, and Seed Audio.
- Adds 1080p support metadata for Seedance 2.5 and complete image and audio input limits.
- Keeps production API routing inside the CLI and removes API endpoint paths from public capability responses.
- Fixes local asset registration to use the production multipart form contract.
- Defaults supported Seedance video requests to generated audio while preserving an explicit silent-video choice.
- Limits public account output to the minimum identity fields and available credit needed for generation.
- Rejects custom API origins and runtime capability overrides before an API Key is read.
- Installs `agents/openai.yaml` and verifies every remotely downloaded release payload with SHA-256.

## Install

Requirements: macOS or Linux, Python 3.10+, and `curl`.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AstroxNetwork/skills/v0.2.1/install.sh | sh
```

Run the same command again to upgrade or repair an installation. Local API Key configuration and task history are preserved.

## Paid-task safety

The CLI estimates credit first and requires explicit confirmation before creating one billable task. It does not automatically retry a paid submission after an ambiguous network result. Intentionally repeating the same prompt remains supported as a new confirmed draw.

## Validation

The release gate covers Python unit tests, compilation, capability consistency, the official Skill validator, macOS/Linux installation, MCP initialization, SHA-256 tamper rejection, and public-boundary scanning. Release validation does not submit a paid generation task.

HolyCrab CLI collects no additional telemetry. Service use is governed by the [Privacy Policy](https://holycrab.ai/privacy/) and [Terms of Service](https://holycrab.ai/terms/). For support, contact `cs@holycrab.ai`.
